method: blind extraction with class4_child1_cert_extractor_exact_ms23.ts (the repo-verbatim extractor_exact with the single MS=1<<18 -> MS=1<<23 memo-capacity line substitution; engine v15 inlined; FBS unchanged; empty kill table via cert_driver73l.ts import; per-bit fresh process; rows deduplicated and sorted before write; the MS line bounds only the memo capacity and does not change the extracted row set - published prescription, ~-30% extraction nodes vs MS=1<<18), fbt_drops=0 on all thirty-two, no fatal, no capped per-move; independent verification with verify_bit7_win7_cert.ts (Bareiss 4x4, engine-free), orchestrated by verify_cost73l_one.sh: root-check stones=7 and loser mobility equals the independent legal_candidates.py enumeration on the RAW root, all sub-roots PASS on every root, terminal stone range within [13,17] on every sub-root, consumed-winner-state union vs certificate row set 0 missing / 0 extra in both directions on every root (re-verified from the saved certkeys/consumed artifacts when building this manifest); determinism: fresh-process re-extraction byte-identical (md5) on six of the thirty-two bits [1,9,47,61,64,116], each re-extracted in a fresh process with byte-identical md5 (sample spans 1019711 to 2754504 published bytes and 353902 re-extracted rows in total); the same blind-extraction and engine-free verification pipeline as the 69j/66j/71e/72d/73j/73k certificate lanes; the sweep the certificates come from passed all its planned controls: 9/9 pilot controls exact (loss=false at exactly 3,402 nodes), determinism reruns of batches 1 and 4 (batch 4 holds the heaviest search bit 47, 6,045,349 nodes) field-identical on every non-ms field, independent v15 cross-engine re-check 34/34 WIN agreement (pilots 5,949 exact, 0 capped, v15 node total 286,284,260), 7/7 head-1473 census-v8 confirmation transfers re-run fresh and matching the predicted verdicts (2 WIN7-D10 covered by published certificates, 5 REFUTED-D10; every transfer canon-equality independently re-derived in the raw sweep audit); first execution of this child (no concurrent-session overlap, no sandbox reset); bit 91 (REFUTED-D10) closed its sweep search at 13-15 stones, the only terminal-range exception among the 73 bits; loser defenses are enumerated on the RAW child|bit root (the certificate root), never on its D4 canonical image
